After-hours drop of -11.74% is orderly within the 14.96% options implied weekly move ($43.00 straddle)

pm_takeaway: ILMN delivered a high-quality headline beat (Revenue $1,129.0M vs $1,120.0M, Non-GAAP EPS $1.62 vs $1.36) and raised full-year guidance across revenue, margins, and EPS. However, trading at an elevated trailing multiple of ~54x P/E, investors penalized the modest +0.6% full-year top-line raise and persistent academic budget caution, driving shares down -11.74% to $256.00. The sell-off represents a classic multiple re-rating rather than an operational breakdown.
